note: Kyberion -> Chrome extension pull mailbox (libs/shared-vision/src/browser-bridge-mailbox.ts), one JSON per request under <tier>/<tenant|shared>/. Requests live at most 60 minutes and are swept to expired on the next poll; enqueue is audited on the audit chain, so the files are consumable request/response hand-offs. A 7d grace lets a caller read a late response; tenant offboarding purges the tenant partitions.
